title: Back each category claim with an example
statement: Back every claim a lesson makes about a category with an example the students actually meet in it.
example: One draft unit teaches that a poem can refuse to rhyme, yet all 5 of its poems rhyme.
detail: A draft Grade 4 poetry unit tells students that a poem can rhyme or can refuse to (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Texts/G4 DRAFT/12. Poetry - Narrative and Lyric.docx`, line 285 of its text), yet all five of its poems rhyme: The Highwayman, Lochinvar, My Shadow, Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening and I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud (lines 216 and 217 are one rhyming pair). The unit's own texts give students no instance of half of what it teaches. It was first noticed in a review of the unit; the draft itself is the evidence here.
